decisions.reason: A standalone passenger check-in mobile app is the least differentiated from standard airline software and sits furthest from the firm's core high-end security offering, so we would likely redeploy resources elsewhere.

The passenger processing technology line fits our airport and airline customer base, supports efficiency and customer-flow goals, and its formal multi-model launch indicates a strategic platform worth retaining.

The self-service airline check-in solution complements our integrated airport services and remains relevant for automation and contactless processing, even if it overlaps somewhat with broader passenger processing technology.
